description: This file defines classes and functions related to sale orders, sale order lines, sale shops, and sale configuration policies in an OpenERP (Odoo) module, including methods for order processing, invoicing, stock management, and configuration.

classes.name: sale_shop
classes.description: Model representing a sales shop with associated payment, warehouse, pricelist, and analytic account.

classes.name: sale_order
classes.description: Model representing a sale order with methods for order processing, invoicing, stock management, and state transitions.

classes.name: sale_order_line
classes.description: Model representing individual sale order lines with methods for invoice creation, product change, and quantity calculations.

classes.name: sale_config_picking_policy
classes.description: Transient model for configuring default picking and shipping policies.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a sale order with default draft state and new sequence.

methods.name: _amount_line_tax
methods.description: Calculates total tax amount for a sale order line.

methods.name: _amount_all
methods.description: Computes untaxed amount, tax, and total for a sale order.

methods.name: _picked_rate
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of picked items in a sale order.

methods.name: _invoiced_rate
methods.description: Calculates the invoiced percentage of a sale order.

methods.name: _invoiced
methods.description: Checks if a sale order is fully invoiced.

methods.name: _invoiced_search
methods.description: Search method for filtering sale orders based on invoicing status.

methods.name: _get_order
methods.description: Retrieves sale order IDs from sale order lines.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes sale orders if they are in draft or canceled state.

methods.name: onchange_shop_id
methods.description: Updates sale order fields based on selected shop.

methods.name: action_cancel_draft
methods.description: Resets sale order to draft state, clears invoices, and resets workflow.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates partner-related fields when partner is changed.

methods.name: shipping_policy_change
methods.description: Adjusts invoice quantity policy based on shipping policy.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to synchronize invoice quantity with order policy.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides create method to set invoice quantity based on order policy.

methods.name: button_dummy
methods.description: Dummy method for button actions.

methods.name: _inv_get
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving invoice data for a sale order.

methods.name: _make_invoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice for a sale order, copying existing draft invoices if any.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Generates invoices for sale order lines, grouped or individual, and updates order state.

methods.name: action_invoice_cancel
methods.description: Cancels invoices and updates sale order lines invoiced status.

methods.name: action_invoice_end
methods.description: Finalizes invoicing, updates line states, and sale order status.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels sale orders, attached pickings, invoices, and updates workflow.

methods.name: action_wait
methods.description: Transitions sale order to progress or manual state, logs event.

methods.name: procurement_lines_get
methods.description: Retrieves procurement IDs associated with sale order lines.

methods.name: test_state
methods.description: Checks if all lines are finished or canceled based on mode.

methods.name: action_ship_create
methods.description: Creates stock pickings and procurements for sale order lines.

methods.name: action_ship_end
methods.description: Marks sale order as shipped and updates line states.

methods.name: _log_event
methods.description: Logs a sale order event for tracking.

methods.name: has_stockable_products
methods.description: Checks if sale order contains stockable products.
